title: Splitting a cube into two blocks
statement: For natural numbers $m$ and $p$, the vector space of functions from an $(m+p)$-element index set to $mathbb{F}_2$ is linearly equivalent to the product of the corresponding spaces of functions on $m$ and $p$ coordinates, by splitting the coordinates into two consecutive blocks.
